items.title: Jameela Jamil ATTACKED For Being Straight - Comes Out As Queer? | Ep 137
items.description: Social justice activist Jameela Jamil recently faced backlash after accepting a role on HBO Max's new show "Legendary," which focuses on an aspect of LGBT culture called "ballroom." Critics were upset she would be participating on this show as a straight woman, prompting Jamil to come out as queer.
